Vorn.bark: Protects allies and holds the frontline.
Vorn.playstyle: Vorn protects the Party by standing between his allies and danger. He can gain Shield, prevent damage, and keep enemies focused on him.
abilities: Gains Shield to absorb incoming damage
Prevents damage for himself and his allies
build: Recommended Gift: Bulwark Shield, another way to Prevent damage for yourself or a teammate

Lorelai.playstyle: Lorelai controls the battlefield by moving enemies, disrupting their plans, and creating openings for the Party.
build: Recommended Gift: Bauble of Power, an incremental damage bonus for your magic Skills

Jaheen.bark: Heals, protects, and removes harmful effects.
Jaheen.playstyle: Jaheen keeps the Party standing by healing allies, protecting them from harm, and helping the group recover from dangerous effects.
abilities: Helps the group recover from dangerous effects
build: Recommended Gift: Heroic Heart, improves your Cleanse effects

Maya.bark: Focuses on damage and priority targets.
Maya.playstyle: Maya is the Party's main damage dealer, focusing on precise attacks and taking down key enemies before they can threaten the group.
abilities: Main damage dealer of the Party
Takes down key enemies before they threaten the group
build: Recommended Gift: Weakening Dagger, some protection and another chance to trigger Best Friends

Elros.bark: Coordinates the Party and enhances his allies.
Elros.playstyle: Elros leads the Party by coordinating his allies, allowing them to act beyond their turns and fight as a unified force.
abilities: Lets allies act beyond their turns
Makes the Party fight as a unified force
build: Recommended Gift: Boots of Haste, reach advantageous positions or make an extra attack
